title: Cobblemon: Hammers
description: Craft hammers from Cobblemon evolution stones.
body:
# Cobblemon: Hammers

A Cobblemon side-mod that introduces 10 craftable hammers craftable from Pokémon evolution stones, each mining a 3x3 area with tier progression from Iron to Netherite equivalent.

---

## Showcase

![Third Person View](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a7110d91a09de35a41c5d1619e876dfd506073da.png)
![First Person View](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cd640edc03007d705e132240fb20f05caa9d18ba.png)
![Creative Tab](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/74aa7aac5fec7d760a288c03b1035ac12f0df3cf.png)
![JEI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4468d61b259fdcc362f663dc820bd4837e63f985.png)

---

## Features
- 10 hammers crafted from Cobblemon evolution stones.
- 3x3 area mining.
- Crouch to mine a single block.
- Three tier progression - Iron, Diamond and Netherite equivalent.
- Enchantable.
- JEI recipe integration.
- Creative tab.

---

## Hammers

| Hammer | Tier | Evolution Stone |
| :--- | :---: | :---: |
| Fire Stone Hammer | Iron | Fire Stone |
| Water Stone Hammer | Iron | Water Stone |
| Leaf Stone Hammer | Iron | Leaf Stone |
| Ice Stone Hammer | Iron | Ice Stone |
| Thunder Stone Hammer | Iron | Thunder Stone |
| Moon Stone Hammer | Diamond | Moon Stone |
| Sun Stone Hammer | Diamond | Sun Stone |
| Shiny Stone Hammer | Diamond | Shiny Stone |
| Dusk Stone Hammer | Netherite | Dusk Stone |
| Dawn Stone Hammer | Netherite | Dawn Stone |

---
